result.document_summary: A portion of San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 5 (Public Safety) covering vehicle forfeiture sale procedures, unmanned aircraft systems rules, and zoo trespass provisions, with no rental housing content despite the source URL naming a Division 11 algorithmic rent-pricing section.
result.notes: No rules in the six in-scope rental housing categories appear in this part. The text covers vehicle forfeiture and sale (Municipal Code §§ 52.5314-52.5324), Unmanned Aircraft Systems (Div. 54), and Zoo trespass (Div. 60 beginning). The URL references San Diego's algorithmic rent price-fixing prohibition (section 98.1103), but the retrieved text does not contain that provision, so nothing is extracted and no rule is inferred from the URL.
